objections.about: The reply tells the customer that a PNG is not a reason to reject the source because Blotato converts non-JPEG images, a claim it gives no basis for, while the error may be caused by the image format, so the customer may skip the one change that could fix the failure.

The customer asked whether 1080x1920 is too tall and whether to shrink to a 1080 maximum side, but the reply never says whether 1080x1920 is within limits and only says the limit is 'area-based' without giving the number, so the customer cannot check their size.
